messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — planning a 45m livestream/demo + OSS refapp launch for next Thu (May 12). Goal: show the refapp, run a 5-minute benchmark live vs baseline, and funnel attendees to the repo + signup. Thoughts?

Ari Patel: love it. Key ask: do we have a short benchmark script that runs in <2 mins? for live demo.

Samir: I can trim the benchmark to 90s — runs local quantized model on a single A10G. I'll post the command.

Samir: ```bash
./run_benchmark.sh --model redwood/refapp-small --batch 1 --seq 256 --iters 100
``` 

Priya: I'll own the landing page + GH release notes. Need the hero screenshot and 3 bullet points for value prop. Draft CTA: "Try the refapp — deploy in 5 minutes". OK?

Maya Chen: @Priya yes. Add an optional "Get host credits" CTA for hosted trial. Also capture registrations in HubSpot list "Refapp Webinar May12".

Ari Patel: For the webinar narrative: 1) Problem + cost/latency baseline 2) Live demo + benchmark 3) How Redwood routing/kv cache helped 4) Q&A + next steps. Keep slides to 10 max.

Priya: Draft tweet thread for launch:

Priya: "1/ Today we're open-sourcing a reference app that demonstrates production LLM inference patterns — low latency, KV caching, and routing. Join our livestream May 12."

Priya: "2/ Live benchmark: see real cost & latency improvements vs naive serving. Code + deploy templates included. https://rwd.in/refapp"

Maya Chen: Love. Add a short sample snippet for the repo README showing the routing config.

Samir: ```yaml
routing:
  - policy: latency_priority
  - fallback: quantized-small
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
``` 

Liam: I'll run the dry-run rehearsal Tue. Can we get a list of attendee questions to prep answers? I'll mock Qs: "How does batching affect latency?" "Can we use this on-prem?" "What are cost tradeoffs?"

Maya Chen: Good list. @devrel-bot please create a repo issue "webinar assets" and assign @Priya, @Samir, @Liam.

devrel-bot: created issue #48 "webinar assets" assigned to Priya, Samir, Liam :white_check_mark:

Priya: I'll update the marketing calendar + set registration form (collect company, job title, intent). Also routing rule: any enterprise email triggers SDR flow in HubSpot.

Ari Patel: I'll prepare the benchmark slides with graphs. Need raw numbers by EOD Mon.

Maya Chen: Great. Action items captured. Next sync Thu 3pm PT to finalize slides and promcoms. :rocket:

Liam: :thumbsup:
